title: Add remember me option to login
commit_message: Add remember me option to login
body:
## Summary

Login accepts rememberMe. When true, the token lasts 30 days instead of 1 hour.

## Changes

* token.sign takes a remember option
* login passes rememberMe to the token

## How to test

Login with rememberMe true and false and compare the exp claim.

verixa_should_cover: Login without rememberMe gives a 1 hour token
Login with rememberMe gives a 30 day token
Token with remember flag must still expire (BUG: it never expires)
